prerequisites: Current application CI for exact commit must succeed before any mutating workflow; existing Bandit/Trivy gates are preserved.

Each apply needs a separately reviewed private binary plan, exact source/input/provider/backend bindings and a NEW int approval within 24 hours. No -target, state adoption, replacement prefix, force-unlock or silent replan.
Foundation requires no secret payloads or published image. The mandatory prepared image digest is bound for review only.

After a separately approved foundation apply: owner verifies disk ID and SSH host key, supplies protected GitHub secrets and valid PG server certificate with SAN IP10.80.1.2, performs one explicit blank-disk initialization, and publishes pinned Secret Manager versions.
Runtime needs exact scanned OCI digest published, pinned existing secret versions, configured PG, then protected migration/admin bootstrap Jobs and independent cloud acceptance.

Existing initial-state identity pin remains separate. Runtime dispatch must explicitly supply the owner-reviewed post-foundation receipt name/generation/SHA/size; exact42 managed addresses, current state bytes/generation/lineage/serial, exact parent plan and successful protected apply run are checked. Missing or changed provenance stops planning.
Backup bucket retention and creator IAM are proposed. Automated PG backups and a real restore must be reviewed and demonstrated before data-protection acceptance; no backup success is claimed.
IAP service agent must exist when enabling built-in IAP. No service-identity data source, API activation or key is used during planning. Failures remain explicit; no automatic IAM expansion.
